_source.keys_used: runs[ARM|seed].stats[i] (one entry per evaluation, step 0 = the initialized model, then every 1200 updates) and curve
_source.built_by: video/data/_build/build_gate.py (python3, no torch; run from any directory)
_source.all X: every run here is from results/X; L's per-eval gate statistics are not in the repo except in results/L/early_recipe_results.json

fields.stream_gate: S x k matrix: each stream's mean read gate (channel distribution) at that stream's value positions on the probe batch (test_scale_axes.py:298; 4 dp in the source, 3 dp here). Uniform = 1/k everywhere; routed = one channel per stream near 1.
fields.ch_map: argmax channel of each stream's row of stream_gate (stream 0 first)
fields.one_to_one: every stream has a different argmax channel
fields.margin: routing margin at the query: g_q . g_target minus the mean over the other streams' bindings of g_q . g_distractor (test_router_layout.py:262-270); 1 = perfectly routed, 0 = uniform
fields.eta_key_by_*: k=2: eta^2 of the read gate's channel-0 probability at key positions grouped by stream / triple index / half / key (test_router_layout.py:241)
fields.etak_*: k>2: multichannel eta^2 pooled over channels (test_scale_axes.py:259 eta2_multi), groups stream / index / block / key, at key (etak_key_*) or value (etak_val_*) positions
fields.hs_eta_*: the hinge's own pooled statistic at key positions (test_slow_start.py:428 extra_stats); the hinge penalises hs_eta_index and hs_eta_half above 0.2
fields.val_cos: k=2: cosine between the two streams' mean read gates at value positions; DISCOVERED needs < 0.5 at the end (test_multilayer_binding.py:360)
fields.eff_ch: exp(entropy) of the read gate averaged over all positions (test_router_reliability.py:262)
fields.spread: mean normalised distance of the gate from uniform: 0 = uniform, 1 = one-hot
fields.acc: held-out accuracy at that step (null at step 0: no evaluation before training)
